thread:
sara_support: Received an urgent escalation from Acme (Pat). They started getting wrong Invoice summaries after our 04:10 UTC canary push. They included a couple of bad examples, flagging PII leakage across invoices.

pat_acme: Example from our dashboard: request at 04:12 UTC for invoice 9988 -> response contains items and customer name from invoice 7766. We pinned requests with x-redwood-model: v2-quant. Happened immediately after your deploy.

sara_support: copying infra + runtime. tagging as P1 since this exposes other customers' data.

eli_sre: looking into routing/rollback. initial thought: some shared KV/prefix cache returned a prefix generated under a different model variant. do we have cache read logs for Acme requests?

mike_runtime: pulled logs. suspicious entries:

```
[2026-03-16T04:11:58Z] req=zyx987 cache_key=prefix:3f5a hit=true payload.model_variant="" served_variant=baseline-v1
[2026-03-16T04:11:58Z] req=zyx987 resolved_model=v2-quant
```

mike_runtime: payload.model_variant blank or missing in many entries. means the cached prefix lacks metadata tying it to a variant.

jess_prod: if the cache key doesn't encode the resolved variant id, then when an alias maps to a new variant the old cached prefix can be reused. that matches the repro.

mike_runtime: repro steps I ran in staging to confirm:
1) send request with model alias header (x-redwood-model: prod-invoice) which resolves to baseline-v1 initially
2) response contains invoice A
3) rollout changes alias to v2-quant for 15% of traffic
4) same request (still using alias) returns invoice B but sometimes returns invoice A content due to cache hit

curl I used:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-redwood-model: prod-invoice" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize invoice 9988","use_prefix_cache":true}'
```

sara_support: customer tried account-scoped cache flush and said it fixed things temporarily.

mike_runtime: confirmed local flush clears the mismatch. short-term mitigation: instruct support to run account cache flush and hold further rollouts until patch.

jess_prod: what's the minimal patch? want to ship ASAP.

mike_runtime: two-pronged fix:
- include resolved_model_id (not alias) in prefix cache key
- when reading a cached payload, ensure cached_payload.model_variant == resolved_model_id; if mismatch or missing, treat as miss
- set a TTL (24h) and add a migration that invalidates older keys lacking model info

buggy snippet:

```
# old
cache_key = f"prefix:{prefix_hash}"
# new
cache_key = f"prefix:{prefix_hash}:variant:{resolved_model_id}"
```

redwood_bot: deploy-bot: rolled patch "prefix-cache-variant-key" to canary at 05:25 UTC. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/patches/998. CI passed.

eli_sre: added an alert to surface any prefix cache hits where payload.model_variant is empty or mismatches the resolved variant. threshold: 0.2% over 3m per customer. runbook step: flush account prefix cache, rollback canary.

mike_runtime: added unit tests and an integration test simulating alias -> variant switch during canary. also added a migration job that scans for keys without ":variant:" and deletes them.

pat_acme: we ran a cache flush per your instruction and monitored for 45 minutes. behavior returned to normal. thanks for the quick turnaround.

jess_prod: postmortem action items:
- enforce cache-key invariants in rollout checklist
- require a canary gating metric that monitors cross-variant cache hits
- add a short time-window disable for prefix cache during alias flips

sara_support: updated Acme ticket and marked resolved externally. keeping this thread open for 48h to watch for regressions.

eli_sre: note for postmortem: consider making prefix cache opt-in for model-aliased traffic, or ensure alias resolution happens before any caching decisions. we'll review tradeoffs.

mike_runtime: root cause summary for postmortem: prefix cache keys omitted resolved model variant id when alias-based routing was used. this allowed prefixes produced by one variant to be returned to requests routed to another variant. fix: include resolved variant id in cache keys, add defensive mismatch check, TTL, and migration to purge old keys. patch deployed to canary and then prod.

sara_support: great work. closing the Slack escalation thread now. :white_check_mark:
